name: tsw-thomas-dtg-thejag
title: Thomas
eyebrow: Thomas & Friends · West Somerset Railway · Dovetail Games · TCA Quadrant Airbus
route: West Somerset Railway: Bishops Lydeard – Minehead
setup: Thomas drives on simple controls: one spring-loaded handle for power and brake, no fireman duties; the backhead is decoration
Reverser to Forward (speedbrake lever) at a stand
depart: Close doors (RUD TRIM), check the signal
Move the left lever into the power zone; the handle only acts while the lever moves or ENG 1 (power hold) is up
The train coasts when nothing is sent; brake with the lever past 0 or with ENG 2 (brake hold) up
Whistle on the right throttle button
